title: DIY Live Edge Shelves with Natural Wood Edge
excerpt: Two handcrafted live edge shelves made from Portuguese pine slabs, celebrating the natural edge and character of real wood.
body:
## Overview Live edge shelves highlight the natural form of wood, preserving its original contours and unique imperfections. In this project, I built two live edge shelves using Portuguese pine slabs, allowing the natural edge to become the main design feature. ## Why Live Edge Live edge pieces keep the original outline of the tree, making every shelf one of a kind. They add warmth, texture and authenticity to interior spaces, especially when combined with minimalist design and metal hardware. ## Materials Used - Portuguese pine slabs - Epoxy resin - Black metal shelf brackets - Clear varnish ## Epoxy & Finishing Epoxy was used to fill cracks and resin pockets, reinforcing the slabs and turning imperfections into visual highlights. After sanding, two coats of clear varnish were applied to protect the wood and enhance the grain. ## Final Result The finished shelves combine organic shapes with clean lines, making them suitable for living rooms, offices or studios. ## Image Gallery
